notes.title: Update 04
notes.content:
We fixed the game a little more, if we broke something in the process, write to us!
- Added four new achievements, two of which are hidden.
- Fixed the freeze at the blue chests on the third night.
- Removed the ability to progress the battle with the Leshy shooting stick.
- Returned the text about the anchutka to the encyclopedia.
- Added the latest sounds.
- Other small fixes and improvements.

notes.title: “Vasilisa & Baba Yaga” won two awards at RED Game Awards 🏆
notes.content:
“Vasilisa & Baba Yaga” won two awards at RED Game Awards 🏆

Friends, our game was shortlisted in 4 nominations at the conference for game industry professionals RED EXPO:
- best game narrative
- for popularization of Russian culture
- best visual design
- best sound design

We won in two: "Best visual design" and "Best sound design"!

notes.title: UPDATE 03
notes.content:
Fresh updates to our game 

- Fixed bugs that caused bosses to freeze after applying salt.
- Fixed laundry washing, now the shirt is not so aggressive.
- Fixed the doll's dash.
- Fixed a bug where Vasilisa would hang or disappear in the golbz because of jumping.
- Blue chests can now be looked at again if they have already been opened.
- Fixed a bug that caused Vasilisa to freeze at the forest hut.
- Removed the moment left from testing, when pressing the stick the battle would start from the beginning.
- Added new sounds.
- Other small fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Update 02
notes.content:
Fresh updates to our game 

- The combat system has been updated. The doll now always deals damage if it hits an enemy. 
- Updated the fight with the leshy, the boss no longer attacks with his hands without stopping, the roots do not grab the doll from afar.
- Added the ability for the doll to jump in the boat.
- Fixed several bugs in the basement that were causing the game to freeze.
- Fixed (well, we hope) a bug where the controls would disappear.
- Fixed (well, we hope) a problem with broken saves that prevented the game from launching.
- Made the game recognize the Playstation controller.
- Added new sounds.
- Added linux support 
- Other small fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Hotfix 1 / Update 01 / Patch #1:
notes.content:
- Updated loading screen. Now the game will not crash when loading on the studio logo.
- Fixed a bug when Vasilisa sometimes lost control after a battle with a log in the swamp.
- Fixed a bug where Vasilisa could disappear when replaying any goalpost.
- Fixed a bug where Vasilisa's hands could get hung up in the “Brushing Baba Yaga's Hair” mini-game.
- Other small fixes and improvements

Many people ask us where and when we will be able to listen to music from the game. Friends, very soon we will release the soundtrack on streaming platforms and Steam as DLC. Thank you all for your anticipation and feedback!
